chapter: Learning drums and recording on the Coast
title: Recording for Capitol in Los Angeles with Julia Lee
summary: He and Julia Lee recorded for Capitol with a small band including Benny Carter and Vic Dickenson.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Session players on the hits: "I played on that record"

blocks.x: Baby, one episode we left out in the chronology is when you went to the west coast. Didn't you go
to the west coast and cut some records out there for Capitol? You and Julia?
When was that, in the forties?
Was Benny Carter on the band too?
And you hired him for the record gig.
About seven pieces on that band, right?
Yeah, we had to make the band --
Who else was on that band?
Oh, you recorded in a studio, right?
Yeah. They made a recording with us. Nick and -- oh, I can't think of all the guys. About five or six of us. But some of the guys I didn't even know and I can't even think of their names now, man.
Yeah. But that was in the studio in

Yeah, Capitol. That would be in the mid-forties, wouldn't it? About '46, '47. It seems to me I've seen write ups in jazz anthologies referring to Baby and Julia out there with Benny Carter and Vic Dickenson.
It was back in the forties.
